post.summary: The GraphQL API over the same accounts, money and rules
post.description: One address for the whole bank. A GraphQL answer is always HTTP 200: what went wrong is in `errors`, so read the body, not the status. The signed-in session comes from the same cookie as the REST API, demo accounts are read-only, and someone else's data answers as not found. Introspection is on, so the schema explorer at /app/graphql reads the schema from here. A query nested deeper than 8 levels is refused (QUERY_TOO_DEEP).

parameters.name: runKey
parameters.description: Arms planted bugs for this key only (see POST /api/test/flags).

200.description: The GraphQL answer: data, errors, or both

415.description: The body wasn't JSON (JSON_REQUIRED)
